top_news.dek: Anthropic is making 'auto mode' the default setting for Claude Code sessions across Pro, Max, and Team plans starting August 14th.

top_news.title: Meet Shepherd: An Open-Source Python Substrate That Lets Meta-Agents Fork, Replay, and Revert Any Agent Run
top_news.dek: Shepherd is an open-source Python runtime that enables stateful branching, replaying, and reverting for autonomous agent workflows.
top_news.brief: Developed by researchers at Northeastern and Stanford, Shepherd addresses the difficulty of managing agent state during long-running tasks. By capturing the full execution environment, it allows developers to fork or revert agent runs to specific steps, avoiding the cost of full restarts or inefficient forward-patching.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating agent state branching and replay functionality in Shepherd.
